properties.name: Garden of Eden - Site of the Fall
properties.popup: Location of humanity's first sin - Genesis 3:1-7
properties.description: The serpent deceived Eve at the tree of knowledge. Adam and Eve ate the forbidden fruit, bringing death into the world.
properties.debate: The exact location remains disputed. Pre-Flood geography was likely altered dramatically by the global Flood.

properties.name: Tree of Life
properties.description: God placed cherubim and a flaming sword to guard the way to the tree of life after the expulsion.

properties.name: East of Eden (Expulsion Route)
properties.description: God drove Adam and Eve out of the garden eastward. Cherubim guarded the eastern entrance.
properties.debate: This eastward expulsion set the pattern - Cain later went 'east of Eden' (4:16), and humanity migrated to Babel in the east.

properties.name: Cursed Ground
properties.popup: Earth cursed due to sin - Genesis 3:17-19
properties.description: God cursed the ground because of Adam's sin. Thorns and thistles would grow; man would toil by the sweat of his brow.
properties.archaeology: Fossil record shows thorns appear suddenly in geological strata, consistent with the curse narrative.
